genius.notes: Telcoin Digital Asset Bank holds a Nebraska Digital Asset Depository Institution charter granted November 12, 2025. Current issuer pages still promise regular reserve disclosures and monthly external-auditor attestations; no report was located on the eUSD and Digital Cash pages consulted. No Telcoin-specific GENIUS PPSI approval/application was found in the scoped issuer/Nebraska/OCC review on 2026-10-01. Do not treat the state DADI charter as PPSI approval or extrapolate the search to a statement that no issuer has been approved.
